6435531cd4:
The October 7 disaster, the Iron Swords war and the turbulent reality we have been living through since then affect us as individuals and as a society. This impact is also felt in the workplace.

Are you also encountering the impact of trauma in your organization?

- Difficulty returning to routine among employees back from reserve duty
- Heightened anxiety and difficulty functioning among employees and clients
- Extreme reactions by clients to trauma-triggering situations, such as how service providers treat them
- Impatience, anger and disproportionate reactions to frustrating situations among employees and clients

Metiv, the Israel Psychotrauma Center, invites you to an intensive one-day course: "Metiv Space" - developing a trauma-informed organization. In the course you will broaden your understanding of trauma and its effects on employees and clients, and receive tools for leading your organization as a trauma-informed one.

Light refreshments will be served during the day. Dates for upcoming courses will be announced.
